objective: Standard statement: for a three-fold space H (a connected 3-regular triple system that is not 2-colourable) with planar glue, (1) splice lemma: across a tight 3-edge cut, if the contracted vertex lies on three distinct faces of each side's map, a genus-additive gluing has exactly three merged faces, each made of one face from each side, and the Kasteleyn face condition of the induced signings carries over; (2) hence every face of every minimal map of H has length 2 mod 4: the knot's trivial signing is a Kasteleyn signing of each minimal map; (3) for every perfect matching D the Cimasoni-Reshetikhin quadratic form q_D of this Kasteleyn signing vanishes on the class of every difference of perfect matchings, so its Arf invariant does not depend on D; (4) the form splits over the atoms, planar pieces contribute nothing and each Fano atom (genus one) has Arf invariant 0, so the spin structure is even; (5) the spin structures induced by perfect matchings are even on every Fano handle, and on the Fano space they are exactly the three even spin structures of the torus, each induced by 8 of the 24 matchings. Nearest known result: Kasteleyn; Cimasoni-Reshetikhin 2007 (Kasteleyn orientations and spin structures on surface graphs); Galluccio-Loebl; Tesler; Johnson (quadratic forms and spin structures); THREEFOLD-SURFACES-20261030-001A. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved: the knot's signs are Kasteleyn on every minimal map of every three-fold space with planar glue (every face of length 2 mod 4); the induced spin structures are even, independent of the matching, even on every Fano handle; on the Fano torus the matchings induce exactly the three even spin structures, 8 each
title: Kasteleyn faces and even spin structures
